source: scratch lib crate `scratch` (cargo new --lib --vcs none); src/lib.rs holds `pub fn add(a: u64, b: u64) -> u64 { a + b }` and, in `mod tests` with `use super::add;`, 120 unit tests tests::adds_001 to tests::adds_120, each one `assert_eq!` with literal numbers, from `assert_eq!(add(1, 1), 2);` to `assert_eq!(add(120, 120), 240);`; plus tests::sums_a_ledger (`let rows = [3u64, 4, 5];`, then `for (i, r) in rows.iter().enumerate() { println!("ledger row {i}: {r}"); }`, then `assert_eq!(rows.iter().sum::<u64>(), 13, "ledger total");`) and tests::add_exceeds_its_inputs (`assert!(add(1, 1) > 2, "add(1, 1) must exceed 2");`); run with -- --nocapture; cargo test run by capture-shaping.sh in /repo
